tasks.subject: Task 1: Backfill example sentences for all eligible cards
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create scripts/backfill-examples.ts that generates and saves example sentences for every card that has no example and no conjugations.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/backfill-examples.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Script queries all cards where example IS NULL
- [ ] Cards with conjugations are skipped
- [ ] Each remaining card gets an English template sentence translated EN→IT
- [ ] Result saved to cards.example as { italian, english }
- [ ] 100ms sleep between API calls
- [ ] Final summary: ✓ N generated, N failed, N skipped
- [ ] Idempotent — safe to run again

**Verify:** `npx tsx scripts/backfill-examples.ts` → prints per-card results and summary

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/backfill-examples.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsx scripts/backfill-examples.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Script queries all cards where example IS NULL", "Cards with conjugations are skipped", "Results saved to cards.example", "Idempotent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Redesign CardEditor with expand/collapse panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rewrite components/CardEditor.tsx so the main row shows only toggle + italian + english + expand button, with Edit/Conjugate/Delete moved inside an expandable detail panel. Fix mobile edit overflow.

**Files:**
- Modify: `components/CardEditor.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Main row contains only: toggle, Italian (+ gender badge + speak btn), English, expand button
- [ ] Cards with metadata show blue pill with count, always visible
- [ ] Cards without metadata show muted ⋯ (hover-only desktop, always mobile)
- [ ] Expanded panel shows plural, example, and Edit/Conjugate/Delete
- [ ] Clicking Edit sets editing=true and expanded=false
- [ ] Edit mode inputs stack vertically on mobile (flex-col sm:flex-row)
- [ ] Toggle still works directly without opening panel
- [ ] Conjugation editor still works

**Verify:** Load edit page on desktop and 375px mobile viewport. Verify clean main row, working panel, no overflow on mobile.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/CardEditor.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "open http://localhost:3000/sets/<any-id>/edit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Main row is clean", "Expand button toggles panel", "Edit/Delete in panel", "No mobile overflow"]}
```
